title: Outdoor living area minimum area (Table 1.1a)
text: Outdoor Living Area (applies to R2-R25 only). C1.1.1 An outdoor living area to be provided in accordance with Table 1.1a. (Refer to Figure 1.1a) Table 1.1a Outdoor living area provisions. Minimum outdoor living area (m2): R2-R15 No minimum applicable; R17.5 36m2; R20-R25 30m2.

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: diverges: coding R2-R25 (Chapter 3 p9 'Outdoor Living Area (applies to R2-R25 only)'; Table 1.1a has no R30-R40 rows, Chapter 2 runs to R40). Grouped R30 and above use the primary garden area (C1.1.3). Area test only; dimension, roof cover and location are C1.1.1-r1 to -r3. R2-R15: no minimum (table row null). Figure 1.1a note: OLA accessible from the primary living space (not tested).
